The plugin resolves every engine address from this build's own `.sym` at load time, so the target needs no source change. `verification.required` stays `contract` because hosted CI cannot run this pin: the plugin's unit and native connector suites run on every build, but a real boot needs a Dragonwilds Linux dedicated server (~5.1 GB Steam depot) that a hosted runner does not install. The runtime results from a manual run on a real server are listed under evidence.

notes: One image builds and tests the plugin: node:*-bookworm (not slim) carries g++ on the same glibc as the dedicated server image, and Dockerfile.builder adds the four pinned static libraries on top of it. The server itself is a plain Steam depot install (no container images to load), so it installs through the shared Steam exact-install path like Conan Exiles.
